_note: Config for the deterministic, metadata-only spam-PR scorer scripts/spam-pr-score.sh (epic #1200, story #1203; signal table per discussion #1198). Every number and list here is DATA, not code — the scorer hardcodes none of them. ALL values below are CONSERVATIVE STARTING DEFAULTS and are explicitly TUNABLE (Phase 5 tunes them against the frozen fixtures under tests/fixtures/spam-pr-guard/). Rides standards/v1-stable, so every consumer reads the same config as the scorer at the same cut.
_thresholds_note: Tunable. A scored PR's raw points total maps to a level: >= high -> high, >= medium -> medium, else low. Only `high` without escalation is auto-close eligible.
_weights_note: Tunable. Points added when each signal fires (discussion #1198). empty_template fires when sc_description_missing (scripts/lib/safety-checks.sh) reports >= signals.empty_template_min_missing missing sections; the scorer multiplies that 0/1 indicator by the weight.
_signals_note: Tunable signal parameters. burst_limit is N: the burst signal fires when the author has MORE THAN N open PRs created org-wide in the last 24h. new_account_days: accounts younger than this many days count as new. no_activity_max_public_repos / no_activity_max_followers: a new account at or below both counts as having no activity (public_repos defaults to 1 because the PR's own fork is a public repo). small_doc_diff_max_lines: the docs-only diff fires when max(total additions, total deletions) is at or below this.
_associations_note: Gate (story #1203 AC2). Bots (author type `Bot`) and exempt associations score 0 and are never flagged or escalated. Otherwise a PR is scored when its author_association is in `scored`, or when it comes from a fork. Any author_association in neither list, on a non-fork PR, is not scored.
_bare_title_patterns_note: Tunable. Case-insensitive POSIX EREs matched against the trimmed PR title; any match fires bare_title. They target titles that are just a file name or a generic verb plus a single token (e.g. `Update README.md`), not descriptive titles.
_doc_paths_note: Tunable. Bash glob patterns (`*` also matches `/`) for README/docs files. The small-docs-diff signal fires only when EVERY changed file matches one of these.
_linked_issue_patterns_note: Tunable. Case-insensitive POSIX EREs; a PR body matching any of them is treated as linking an issue, which suppresses small_doc_diff_no_issue.
_typo_words_note: Tunable. Common misspellings, lowercase. typo_introduced fires when an ADDED patch line contains one of these as a whole word and no REMOVED line of the same file does (the edit introduces the typo).
_security_sensitive_paths_note: Tunable list, same intent as standards/workflow-exemptions.json: paths agents must never act on unreviewed. Bash glob patterns (`*` also matches `/`). A scored PR that changes ANY matching path gets escalate=true and is NEVER auto-close eligible, whatever its score (story #1203 AC6). Covers workflows/actions, secrets/credentials, and install/bootstrap scripts.
